text:
Tara: Heads-up — Prospect (HarborTrust Capital) asked for our SOC 2 report before their procurement team will sign the POC SOW. They want a redacted copy available to their security reviewers this week.
Liam: We normally require a signed NDA + explicit reviewer list. Can do a redacted PDF, view-only link, and set expiry. Recommend TTL 72h.
Priya: Legal: we can accept the counterparty signing our standard Mutual NDA or their standard if its within our playbook. Required: signed PDF attached to the request, list of reviewer names + emails, and the intended use statement. No downloads allowed; watermark required.
Tara: Buyer asked if we can pre-sign a one-off access link so they can start review before legal finishes countersign. Is that allowed?
Liam: Security: we cannot provide raw evidence or logs. Allowed: redacted report and control summary. If they need more, we escalate to a formal SOC2 bridge letter which takes ~5 business days.
Priya: Also need to limit access to max 4 reviewers. Please capture corporate emails (not personal). Add a short clause in the NDA: "review copies only, no reproduction, no screenshots if possible" — we'll enforce via watermark and view restrictions.
Tara: Ops, can you create a view-only presigned URL that disables GET?
ops-bot: We can provide a presigned object with headers that instruct the viewer but S3 presigned URLs allow download. We can instead serve via our secure-docs viewer which enforces no-download and overlays watermark. Workflow: upload redacted version to secure-docs, generate ticketed access, create ephemeral token (TTL 72h). Example CLI to upload:

```
# upload redacted snapshot
aws s3 cp soc2-redacted-harbortrust.pdf s3://redwood-secure/soc2/ --acl private
# then create viewer token via our access service
redwood-cli docs grant --file soc2/redacted-snapshot.pdf --reviewers "a@example.com,b@example.com" --ttl 259200
```
Priya: Please include the following fields in the access request: purchaser company name, PO number if available, list of reviewers, signed NDA filename, IP allowlist (optional), and retention period.
Liam: Security note: redact customer-identifying evidence (e.g., customer names in logs), remove CI/CD internal hostnames, and strip audit log raw entries. Attach a redaction checklist when you hand over to ops.
Tara: Buyer says POC kickoff 4 days from now. They're pushing for same-day access. I'll ask for the signed NDA and reviewers ASAP.
ops-bot: Logged internal task DOC-3221 for staging. Please cc Priya when you upload.
Priya: If the counterparty refuses our NDA and insists on their template, send it to legal for quick review. Turnaround typical 24	60h depending on redlines.
Liam: If they ask for more detailed validation (diagram of controls), we can provide an executive controls summary but not system diagrams. For bridge-letter level commitments, escalate to Legal + Compliance.
Tara: OK — I'll gather the signed NDA and reviewer list. Will post here once uploaded. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
LegalBot: Reminder: attach NDA to the legal queue with subject "SOC2 access request - HarborTrust".
